environment_assumptions.单居住热区、2.8米层高、南北朝向的矩形等效住宅；不重建真实户型。: A single occupied thermal zone, 2.8 m floor-to-ceiling height and an equivalent rectangular north-south-oriented home; the actual floor plan is not reconstructed.
environment_assumptions.公寓及联排住宅侧墙按相邻空间等温处理；公寓楼板按所报楼层位置设置。: Apartment and row-house side walls are modeled with adjacent spaces at equal temperature; apartment floor and ceiling boundaries follow the reported floor position.
environment_assumptions.围护结构材料及冷热源、热水设备继承原EB天津模型，未按建筑年代或当地存量住宅校准: Envelope materials, heating/cooling and hot-water equipment inherit the original EB Tianjin model; they are not calibrated by building age or local housing stock.
environment_assumptions.取消独立住宅阁楼及对应AirflowNetwork/旧遮阳几何，采用闭合的住宅单: The detached-house attic and associated AirflowNetwork/old shading geometry are removed in favor of closed dwelling-unit geometry; attic duct leakage is not simulated.
environment_assumptions.面积区间采用代表值；建筑面积转室内面积时暂用0.8研究假设，不作为用户实测面积。: Area bands use representative values; a research factor of 0.8 converts gross area to indoor area, not a measured indoor area.
environment_assumptions.ge160档采用180平方米代表值，不表示覆盖任意大小住宅。: The ge160 band uses a representative area of 180 m2; it does not represent homes of arbitrary size.
environment_assumptions.最大预热天数增至60，保持原收敛容差；预热不作为问卷的比较日。: Maximum warmup days are increased to 60 with the original convergence tolerances; warmup is excluded from the questionnaire comparison day.
environment_assumptions.未匹配到同城站点，本次使用省内代表站作研究近似；不表示最近站或您所在地实测天气。: No same-city station matched; a provincial representative station is used as a research approximation, not necessarily the nearest station or observed weather at the home.
